episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth.

episodes.name: Cat's in the Bag...
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends.

episodes.name: ...And the Bag's in the River
episodes.overview: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use.

episodes.name: Cancer Man
episodes.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has cancer.

episodes.name: Gray Matter
episodes.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party.

episodes.name: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
episodes.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt.

episodes.name: A No-Rough-Stuff-Type Deal
episodes.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer.

name: Season 1
overview: High school chemistry teacher Walter White's life is suddenly transformed by a dire medical diagnosis.
